note: Adapted from the species-level description no. 161 in Chhotani (1997), The Fauna of India, Isoptera; original in English; all three castes present, nymph absent. Synonymy lists, literature citations, figure numbers, distribution records and wing-surface micro-ornamentation omitted; the alate body length without wings (given in the original OCR as "5.2-~.2") and head width (given as "1.01..1.10") are not recorded.

sections.label: Diagnostic characters
sections.text: Soldier head capsule subrectangular, sides almost parallel and slightly convex in the middle; mandibles long and slender, sword-shaped, coarsely serrate without a large tooth, slightly less than two thirds of the head length; postmentum bottle-shaped with a narrow waist at the posterior third. Alate head capsule subquadrate, sides nearly straight; compound eyes far from the lower margin of the head; ocelli separated from the compound eyes by their long diameter; anterior margin of the pronotum with a weak median notch.

sections.label: Soldier
sections.text: Head capsule yellow; antennae and labrum pale yellow; mandibles dark reddish brown, paler at the base; legs and body yellowish white. Head sparsely pilose, body moderately pilose. Body length 4.5–5.0 mm. Head capsule subrectangular (1.33 mm to mandible bases, maximum width 0.83 mm); sides almost parallel, slightly convex in the middle. Fontanelle indistinct. Antennae 13-segmented; segment 2 equal to the sum of segments 3 and 4, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus not clearly delimited from the frons, with several setae. Labrum ligulate, pentagonal, slightly wider than long (length 0.23 mm, width 0.25 mm). Mandibles long and slender, sword-shaped (length 0.83–0.85 mm); slightly less than two thirds of the head length (left mandible length to head length ratio 0.639); coarsely serrate, without large teeth. Postmentum bottle-shaped, waist narrow, at the posterior third (length 0.80 mm, maximum width 0.32 mm, waist width 0.18 mm). Pronotum saddle-shaped; anterior margin convex, with a distinct median notch; length 0.35 mm, width 0.55 mm.

sections.label: Worker
sections.text: Head capsule pale yellow; antennae and body pale yellowish white. Head and body moderately pilose. Body length 3.25–4.70 mm. Head capsule subquadrate (0.65–0.88 mm to mandible bases, maximum width 0.70–0.88 mm). Antennae 12–13-segmented; segment 2 equal to the sum of segments 3 and 4, segment 3 shortest. Postclypeus convex, pilose; about half as long as wide; anterior margin nearly straight, posterior margin rounded and projecting backward in the middle. Pronotum saddle-shaped (length 0.20–0.28 mm, width 0.40–0.50 mm); anterior margin convex, without a median notch; posterior margin straight. Tibial apical spurs 3, 2, 2 or 2, 2, 2, the dorsal spur of the fore tibia often weak, sometimes absent.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Head, thorax and abdomen dark chestnut brown; postclypeus pale brown. Head and body densely pilose, with fine hairs and long hairs. Body length with wings 8.0–9.8 mm. Head capsule subquadrate, sides nearly straight (0.95–1.00 mm to mandible bases). Fontanelle minute, inconspicuous. Compound eyes round-oval (maximum diameter 0.18 mm, minimum diameter 0.16 mm), not much projecting, far from the lower margin of the head. Ocelli small, oval (long diameter 0.072 mm, short diameter 0.045 mm), separated from the compound eyes by their long diameter or slightly more (0.07–0.08 mm). Antennae 14-segmented; segment 2 as long as the sum of segments 3 and 4; segment 3 smallest. Postclypeus convex, about half as long as wide. Pronotum semicircular, with a small white spot slightly above the middle (length 0.47 mm, width 0.74–0.79 mm); anterior margin with a weak median notch, posterior margin rounded. Wings transparent; fore wing length 6.00 mm.
